summary: Responsive-only frontend testing for the Bracket waitlist marketing site. Checked all 6 active public routes (/, /waitlist, /how-it-works, /use-cases, /pricing, /case-studies) across 7 viewports (375, 390, 430, 768, 820, 1280, 1440) = 42 combos. Zero horizontal overflow on every combo (documentElement.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth). Navbar hamburger at <1024px opens a mobile panel containing all nav links plus 'Join the waitlist' CTA; desktop >=1024 shows full nav plus CTA. Waitlist: H1 'Reserve your seat' fits at 375 (font 44px, width 335/375); countdown is 2x2 at 375 (grid-template-columns: 161.5px 161.5px) and 1x4 at 1024; form inputs fill card width (293px in 335px card); submit not clipped. Waitlist POST /api/waitlist returns 200 on new; duplicate returns 409 with friendly error 'You're already on the waitlist. We'll be in touch soon.' CaseStudies BEFORE/AFTER cards stack vertically on mobile with border-bottom=1px and border-right=0px; on desktop same-row with border-right=1px and border-bottom=0px (no dangling-right-border glitch). Pricing tiers stack 1-col @375 (distinct tops 457/833/1240) and 3-col @1024 (same top 596). Currency toggle + 'Join the waitlist' CTA visible in each tier. Landing hero H1 fits at 375 (font 44px). Oversized decorative brackets {,} visually extend past the viewport but are clipped via html/body overflow-x:clip + max-width:100vw so they do NOT cause horizontal scroll. Footer email link uses break-all and does not overflow (emailRight 324 < 375). UseCases rows reflow cleanly on mobile (each row width 335, stacked at tops 476/817/1158/1526).

issues: Email field uses type='text' (placeholder 'you@studio.com') instead of type='email'. Works, but misses native mobile email keyboard + browser-level email validation. Minor UX/a11y improvement.
Both inputs have empty name='' attribute. Works since React controls state, but for a11y/autofill it's nicer to set name='email' and name='name'. Minor.

Two repeating 401s on every initial page load (likely GET /api/me or similar anonymous probe). Not user-visible but adds noise; consider suppressing the 401 log path for unauthenticated marketing routes, or gate the call so it only fires on /app routes.

action_items: (Optional) Switch waitlist email input to type='email' and add name attributes (name='email', name='name') for a11y + autofill.
(Optional) Skip the anonymous /api/me probe on public marketing routes to eliminate the 2x 401 console noise on every page load.
critical_code_review_comments: Responsive strategy (html/body max-width:100vw + overflow-x:clip + .font-display overflow-wrap:anywhere) is effective — no horizontal scroll anywhere — but clipping oversized decorative braces means part of the designed art silhouette is cut on narrow viewports (left=-24, right=399 at 375). Acceptable per spec (no scroll), but main agent may want to tighten bracket sizing or reposition on xs breakpoints purely for visual polish.
Waitlist inputs have empty name attribute — minor a11y/autofill miss.
test_credentials: Waitlist submit test used uitest+<timestamp>@example.com (no auth required; public endpoint).
seed_data_creation: One waitlist entry created per run (uitest+<ts>@example.com) via POST /api/waitlist. Second submit with same email correctly returns 409.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public marketing site has robust responsive implementation. Key data-testids confirmed: nav-mobile-toggle (header hamburger), waitlist-name-input, waitlist-email-input, waitlist-role-{freelance|agency|in-house|student|other}, waitlist-submit-btn, pricing-page, pricing-currency-toggle, pricing-tier-{free|pro|studio}, pricing-cta-{free|pro|studio}, usecase-row-{freelancers|agencies|product designers|junior designers}, currency-toggle-INR, currency-toggle-USD. Waitlist form uses type='text' for email (custom regex validation in JS). POST /api/waitlist returns 200 on new, 409 with detail 'You're already on the waitlist...' on duplicate. No horizontal overflow on any of 42 viewport/route combos tested. Decorative braces on Landing overflow element-bounds but are clipped — by design.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. All 14 responsive requirements in the review request are satisfied.
